free_tier_limits: Free with an API key; limited to 100 calls within five minutes and 50,000 records per response. No daily-call quota is published.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Replace. The live API docs show free email-based key signup and a 50,000-row response cap: https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api. NASS states the request limit is 100 calls within five minutes, not a daily quota: https://data.nass.usda.gov/Education_and_Outreach/Meeting/2025/2025%20Spring%20Data%20Users%20Meeting%20Question%20and%20Answer%20Summary%20with%20Slides.pdf. rate_limits: Replace "not published" with "100 calls within five minutes"; same NASS meeting source.
